lots.key_photo_findings: Signature MACKLEY in black capitals lower right, worked into the paint (enlarged crop). Heavy palette-knife impasto with drip and splatter in the dark teal background; foreground figures, one with a red cape-like shape, before a dense crowd. Same painting was lot 81 in the earlier Gowans online sale (cdid 3059788, closing 6/10/2026, 0 bids at 30/09/2026); its back photo shows canvas on a stretcher, a handwritten 'Pop Concert' strip and a small framer's label (not a gallery label, so no provenance). The stated size 36.5 x 70 cm does not fit the photo: the canvas looks close to 4:3 (roughly 1.4 to 1), not almost 2 to 1.
lots.condition: Paint surface looks sound with no obvious losses in the photo; gilt frame and linen slip clean. Back is taped cardboard backing. Impasto this thick can crack or lose peaks, which needs checking in person.
lots.question_for_gowans: Did this pass in at the 6 October online sale, and at what bid? The catalogue size of 36.5 x 70 cm does not match the picture's proportions: is that the frame or the sight size, and what is the canvas size? Any cracking or losses in the impasto, and any label or provenance beyond the framer's sticker?
